floorPlans.label: Emaar Selvara 4 original floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Compare four-bedroom Villa A and Villa B in Styles 2 and 3, including the mirrored variants shown in the developer booklet. Each sheet shows three floors.
floorPlans.note: The Villa B Style 2 sheets appear to reverse the imperial terrace and carport figures relative to the metric column. The original sheets and printed totals are kept for confirmation.

review.images: Reviewed all six official gallery images and the distinct phase hero, omitting a similar frontage crop. The dusk frontage and three interiors are shared with Selvara 3 and captioned as such.
review.location: Checked the named developer point, cluster map on physical page 9 and the brochure estimates on physical page 6. Brochure and general community site estimate scopes differ. Community comparison: https://www.emaar.com/en/our-communities/grand-polo-club-and-resort
review.floorPlans: Reviewed the exact Selvara 4 booklet despite the shared Emaar filename. All 7 complete phase-specific sheets from the 8-page source are displayed. Page 5 and 6 metric terrace and carport labels do not correspond to the order of the imperial values. Printed total 3689.97 sq ft retained. Style A3 appears once in the pack.

unavailable: No separate Style A3 mirrored sheet appears in the reviewed booklet. The signed Style B2 area breakdown needs confirmation.
Signed unit-specific areas and entrance-level routes were not verified.
